data.reasoning: The package is a standard AUR wrapper for a proprietary binary driver from Synaptics. The PKGBUILD downloads a checksum-pinned archive and extracts it safely using --noexec. All helper scripts (udev.sh, displaylink-sleep.sh) and systemd/udev configurations perform expected local hardware management tasks without network access, data exfiltration, or obfuscated code. The only disagreement was caused by an API error in the first model preventing it from reviewing udev.sh, which the second model successfully reviewed and cleared.
data.disagreement_analysis: The first model (qwen) returned 'inconclusive' solely because its LLM API request failed with an HTTP 400 error when processing udev.sh. The second model (deepseek) successfully reviewed udev.sh and found it safe. The disagreement is an artifact of a tool error, not a genuine security dispute.
coverage_issues: qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507 failed to audit udev.sh due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError)
learnings: Ensure robust error handling and retry logic for LLM API calls to prevent individual file audit failures from cascading into package-level inconclusive verdicts.
When a model fails on a specific file, the orchestration layer should ideally retry or fall back to another model for that specific file rather than failing the entire audit.
